speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: MinLaw will continue to work towards realising our vision of "A Trusted Legal System; A Trusted Singapore".

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will do this through advancing access to justice and the Rule of Law in Singapore and developing our legal services to support our economy and society.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We have worked to ensure that our laws and legal framework are progressive and practical.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are looking into substantive reforms in civil and criminal law.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our aim is to improve the civil justice system, improve enforcement of civil judgments and, where possible, remove unnecessary complexities in the civil justice system.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In the family law sphere, we are working on reforms to the Guardianship of Infants Act, the Intestate Succession Act, and the Inheritance (Family Provision) Act.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also ensure that our criminal justice system continues to protect society from crime and maintain law and order, while upholding due process for all and adhering to the Rule of Law.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will work closely with law practices and lawyers to drive Singapore's development as a hub for international legal services and dispute resolution.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: With the establishment of the Singapore International Commercial Court and the Singapore International Mediation Centre and continued growth of the Singapore International Arbitration Centre, Singapore is well-positioned to offer commercial parties a comprehensive suite of dispute resolution options to support their business needs.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will build on our strengths, help legal practitioners develop expertise in key practice areas, as well as enhance our supporting infrastructure, such as through the expansion of Maxwell Chambers, Singapore's flagship dispute resolution facility.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will look into ways to help the legal industry remain forward-looking and keep up with a rapidly changing economic, social and technological landscape.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will encourage Singapore law practices to raise productivity, deepen service and practice capabilities, encourage product innovation and adopt new technologies.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: On the intellectual property (IP) front, we have made progress to develop Singapore into a global IP hub in Asia.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We are also reviewing Singapore's copyright and design protection regimes to address new developments in technology, as well as to facilitate the growth of the creative sector and copyright and design-related services.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will work with MOE and UniSIM to build up the UniSIM Law School, to train lawyers who will serve the needs of the community in the areas of criminal and family law.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This will also introduce a new pathway for mid-career individuals to join the legal profession.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In line with SkillsFuture, we will also work with the Singapore Academy of Law, Singapore Institute of Legal Education and the Law Society to develop initiatives that support the continuing professional development of lawyers.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: In this way, we can ensure a continued pipeline of high-quality legal talent to meet the needs of our economy and society.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Page: 42 We promote the Rule of Law by providing timely and quality legal policy input to all primary legislation.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We also aim to propagate legal policy principles among public officers and cultivate better public awareness of the law to promote confidence and trust in our legal system.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This goes in tandem with the overall review that we are undertaking on how the cross-border enforcement of Singapore judgments can be strengthened for the benefit of businesses and the legal industry.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also promote Singapore as a neutral venue for inter-state disputes through collaboration with the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea for maritime disputes to be heard in Singapore.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Working with the Singapore Land Authority (SLA), we will continue to ensure optimal use of our land resources and maximise the potential of state land and state properties to help meet Singapore's social and economic objectives.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will explore greater use of subterranean space as Singapore becomes more built-up.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will also promote more innovative use of spaces and allow for greater enjoyment of previously unused state land, such as land under viaducts, for sports, recreational and social purposes.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: To strengthen Singapore's geospatial capabilities in support of the Smart Nation initiative, SLA, together with IDA, will lead efforts to formulate Singapore's Geospatial Master Plan.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: Our smart cadastre capability will also be enhanced.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will continue to push boundaries in technology to improve business processes and land data management.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: The implementation of a paperless registration system will simplify the title registration process and enable more self-service transactions.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We will encourage law firms and the legal profession to continue to partner us in delivering legal aid.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: This will ensure access to justice for less privileged Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: We have also recently modernised the pawnbroking regime.

speaker: The Minister for Law (Mr K Shanmugam)
text: For example, auctions have been abolished, allowing cost savings to be passed on to pawners.
